## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #214 at **6c831f4eb1f293446ecd81cb1ec506849034dc68**, under C33/C34. Reviewed all 39 changed-file diffs and directly relevant source paths. No security vulnerability identified.

| Focus | Source evidence and disposition |
|---|---|
| FYI first-line previews | `crates/core/src/fyi_watch.rs:77-130` renders first lines with `render::fenced`, seat IDs with `SeatId::rendered`, and machine labels with `render::machine`. The fence escapes quotes and controls onto one line. The final delivery paths preserve the rendered text, without shell interpolation or unescaping. |
| PA delivery-time line | `crates/core/src/fyi_watch.rs:137` uses rendered seat IDs, numeric counts/ages and enum states. Contrary to the broader focus wording, this line contains no FYI body preview. The stall notice is the surface that includes fenced first lines. |
| Pending read authority | `/v1/fyi/read` remains outside the federation peer-key allowlist (`crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:440,763`). Its handler requires exactly one read mode (`http/fyi.rs:128`). The pending query is recipient-bound, pending-only and read-only; it does not claim FYIs (`crates/store/src/orchestration.rs:517`). |
| C33 exposure comparison | Any local-key caller can select another seat for pending reads, as the existing delivered-batch read accepts a requested seat (`crates/store/src/queue.rs:1353`). **C33: same-user, out of scope** as a per-seat confidentiality block. This does not grant federation peers that read. |
| F170 and indirect fields | Refresh is restricted to local `pij-bg` notices (`crates/core/src/fyi_watch.rs:207`). Large-seat role/model and idle-notice role/instance/project fields retain their existing renderers (`core/src/watchdog.rs:853`; `daemon/src/http/memory_turn.rs:134`; `core/src/idle_nudge.rs:107`). |
| Skill and public text | The changed horse Part 1 a-h guidance has no identified security blocker or credential/private-content disclosure. The PA's pending-read command matches native CLI grammar (`skills/pij/references/prime/pa.md:81`; `crates/cli/src/main.rs:449`). |

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | None identified in reviewed changes under C33 | - |

**Notes/limits:** full pending bodies use the existing peer-attributed FYI renderer, not the fenced-preview renderer (`crates/core/src/fyi.rs:198,249`); a reader must still treat message bodies as untrusted content. Fencing is not secret scrubbing or general prompt-injection immunity. The documented PA-line, fleet-scope and last-watchdog-round freshness limits remain. No production delivery/display or live stall timing was independently exercised; cost belongs to the performance verdict.

**CI proof:** clean detached worktree HEAD and GitHub/remote heads agree; GitHub reports CLEAN. Run [42744931063](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42744931063) checked merge `7b7987912c10e693f9f54bed70c03654bd301aed`, whose parents are base `04c9e107b2f73497b4142c361bc1e6e0f5d28401` and this exact head. Rust reports **2,376 passed, 6 skipped**. Successful JUnit artifact `13731521048` includes the stall-rule, capped/fenced notice, waiting-line, state-refresh, fleet-line and warning tests. Node 22 reports 2,281 passed/6 skipped; the native extension suite reports 339 passed, zero failed. The latest delivers run succeeds; a superseded cancelled run is not test proof.

Static source review and existing CI only. No local builds/tests, commands under review, product mutations, credential reads or live probes.
